name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A toolkit that takes ordinary command-line programs and gives them the structured descriptions an AI agent needs, so any existing CLI tool becomes something an AI assistant can operate correctly.
buyer: An AI automation agency that needs to plug a client's existing internal command-line tools into an AI agent workflow without rewriting those tools from scratch.
business_use_cases: An automation agency 'agentifies' a client's internal CLI tools so the client's own AI assistant can run day-to-day operations tasks safely.
A dev-tools startup builds and sells ready-made agent-ready wrappers for popular open-source CLI tools.
A platform runs a paid directory of agent-ready tool wrappers, charging tool authors a listing fee.

money_ideas.idea: One-off consulting to wrap a company's internal CLI tools for agent use
Marketplace listing fees for agent-ready tool wrappers

steal_this: Pick one CLI tool a client already depends on, ship a paid 'agent-ready' wrapper for it this weekend, and pitch it as a time-saver.
